svg.title: How to export ChatGPT conversation history: Download it within 24 hours of receiving the email
svg.desc: An English guide to the main sections of this article.

g.text: SEONGWOO CHOI / IT JOURNAL
How to export ChatGPT conversation history: Download it
within 24 hours of receiving the email
ARTICLE GUIDE · 2026-11-01
Check whether self-service export is
available for your account
According to the official Help Center, the
accounts eligible to make a request directly in
Settings are Free, Go, Plus, and Pro individual…
Request an export in Settings (web)
After logging in to chatgpt.com, open Settings
from the profile menu.
Download it within 24 hours after the
email arrives
You will be notified by email or SMS when the
file is ready.
Open the ZIP file and check for the
conversations you need
According to the official documentation, the ZIP
file contains conversation history and
account-related data.
AI-assisted article guide. Read the article and linked sources for details.
